baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal مِمَّا, the passive sequence أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا, and the failed-rescue clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Culpable acts initiate a continuous judgment chain: killing by water, compelled entry into kindled fire, then discovery that every substitute source of aid is absent.

activation_trace.role: The culpable-sin branch gives the opening causal phrase its blame-bearing load.
Killing by drowning supplies the first passive transfer and its lethal completion.
Literal ingress makes the second passive a movement across a boundary into a destination.
The kindled-fire branch supplies the destination as an active burning medium.
Finding or encountering turns the final clause into a failed search for actual rescue.
The other-than branch defines the excluded field of substitute powers.
The worshipped-object branch identifies God as the reference against which substitutes fail.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies the concrete rescue the plural actors cannot obtain.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists drowning, fire, and a lack of helpers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah compresses culpability, two compelled transfers, and the collapse of all substitute aid into one causal judgment process.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjoining passives أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا and the immediate فَلَمْ leave no narrated interval of release.
baseline_models.mechanism: Water first occupies the actors' whole field; ingress then preserves the inside relation while changing its medium to fire. Even what is near remains short of the saving goal, so the sequence has no operative outside.

activation_trace.role: Immersion that takes over an entire field models drowning as total environmental occupation.
Interlaced insides extend the enclosure image from a single threshold to a surrounding condition.
Kindled fire replaces water as the enclosing medium without restoring an exterior.
Nearness short of the goal makes apparent proximity to help function as failed reach.

changed_reading.before: Two successive punishments happen to the same people.
changed_reading.after: The two passives form an unbroken enclosure: the medium changes from water to fire, but no saving outside reappears.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنصَارًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause tests whether any aid is discoverable, available, and truly effective for them. The search field includes wealth-like capacity and every other-than-God locus, but yields no agent able to make them prevail.

activation_trace.role: Encountering a thing makes the negation an experiential failure to locate rescue.
Capacity and abundance widen the failed search from persons to usable means.
Otherness defines the complete alternate support field being tested.
Worship and the worshipped object make the support failure theological as well as practical.
Effective aid is the missing result against which every candidate support is measured.

changed_reading.before: No one came to help them.
changed_reading.after: Their ordeal discloses that the entire alternate support field, personal, material, and cultic, has no effective existence for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Advance warning opens a period in which the outcome can still be averted; postponement then reaches a fixed limit. The focus ayah's completed passives read as the closure of that timed process, not an unannounced eruption.

activation_trace.role: Warning that awakens caution establishes notice before the focus outcome.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporary interval that eventually closes.
A prescribed terminal time turns the later drowning into deadline realization.
Culpable wrongdoing explains why the available warning interval ends in liability.
Killing by drowning is the first realized endpoint after the period of warning.
Compelled ingress continues the realized endpoint beyond death by water.

structural_cues: 71:1 announces painful punishment before the sustained address begins.
71:4 repeats both the appointed term and the impossibility of postponing it once it arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, deferral, and a fixed term; I infer that the focus passives enact the term's closure. Alternatively, 71:25 may report the outcome without foregrounding its schedule.

changed_reading.before: The drowning arrives as a sudden punitive event.
changed_reading.after: The drowning and entry are the matured endpoint of a warned, temporarily deferred, but finally nondeferrable process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiveness is followed by the sending of abundant sky-water and rivers as provision. In the focus ayah, water changes function from sustaining gift to engulfing agent, while the rain-as-succor branch of help is explicitly unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Covering wrongdoing and shielding its bearer establishes the offered protective alternative.
Dispatch and release make sky-water an intentionally sent benefit.
Copious outflow from a source supplies the abundance later reversed by drowning.
A river cutting the earth with flowing water fixes the beneficial hydrological form.
Sinking under water reverses the earlier gift into a medium that overwhelms its recipients.
Rain as succor makes the lack of helpers a failure of water itself to retain a rescuing function.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 presents forgiveness, abundant rain, goods, children, gardens, and rivers as one offered sequence.
The focus ayah places drowning before the explicit negation of all helpers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offered forgiveness, sent abundant water, rivers, drowning, and rain-as-succor; I infer a reversal from provision to judgment. Alternatively, beneficial rain and lethal flood may be parallel uses of water without an intended inversion.

changed_reading.before: Water is simply the instrument of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The same material system offered as protected abundance becomes engulfment, and its rescuing capacity is withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: They answer repeated summons by flight and by constructing a garment boundary over themselves. The focus passives reverse that attempted control: they no longer choose what enters their hearing or what encloses them, but are themselves submerged and made to enter.

activation_trace.role: Literal flight supplies the earlier attempt to escape contact and consequence.
A verbal summons supplies the communicative opening they repeatedly refuse.
A covering laid over something supplies their self-made perceptual barrier.
Garment and covering materialize the barrier used to regulate exposure.
Total immersion replaces their chosen covering with an uncontrollable encompassing field.
Forced ingress reverses their earlier control over access and boundaries.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 varies the invitation across night, day, public declaration, and secrecy.
The focus verbs are passive, removing the agency displayed in their earlier fleeing and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated summons, flight, self-covering, immersion, and forced ingress; I infer a reversal of boundary control. Alternatively, the covering may mark refusal without establishing a spatial counterpart to the focus passives.

changed_reading.before: They refuse the message and later receive punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their chosen barriers become a failed rehearsal of enclosure: those who controlled access by fleeing and covering are finally enclosed and made to cross a boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context describes a life route from emergence out of earth, through return into it, to a renewed exit. The focus preserves the grammar of directed movement but replaces growth and exit with drowning and ingress into fire, withholding any exit clause.

activation_trace.role: Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the model of life as outward growth.
Return after departure supplies the inward phase of a reversible cycle.
Passage to the outside supplies the promised outward completion absent from the focus sequence.
Drowning interrupts ordinary life before the focus's second directed movement.
Ingress points opposite the context's exit and makes the destination decisive.
Kindled fire terminates the counter-route in a consuming rather than generative medium.

structural_cues: 71:17-18 explicitly orders emergence from earth, return into it, and being brought out.
71:25 orders two passive movements but names only ingress after drowning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reversible creation route and a focus route ending in ingress; I infer a counter-cycle in which destination differentiates the actors. Alternatively, the focus may occupy a later phase of the same cycle rather than invert it.

changed_reading.before: Drowning is followed by entry into fire.
changed_reading.after: The focus reuses creation's movement grammar as a counter-route: emergence and exit give way to submersion and terminal ingress.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is made broad and traversable through extended roads and open mountain passes. Drowning then occupies the whole field, erasing its navigable affordances; neither a route nor a helper provides an outside or detour.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and extension supply the open terrestrial field available for movement.
Penetrating along a road supplies purposeful traversal through that field.
An extended traversable road supplies the route whose saving use later disappears.
A wide open pass between mountains maximizes the earlier image of available escape space.
Immersion occupying the whole field converts open terrain into unnavigable enclosure.
Nearness short of the goal models a route that approaches but cannot reach rescue.
Missing effective aid closes the social route after the physical routes are erased.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 gives the spread earth and broad paths an explicit purpose of traversal.
The focus moves from environmental submersion to the negation of every helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad traversable space followed by total immersion and failed aid; I infer that the flood cancels both physical and social escape routes. Alternatively, the path passage may remain a creation sign without functioning as an escape contrast.

changed_reading.before: They drown and cannot obtain assistance.
changed_reading.after: Drowning is the erasure of a formerly open route-system, and the absent helpers close the last nonspatial route out.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following establishes a chain of dependence, retained gods anchor it cultically, and mass misdirection shows it reproducing socially. The focus plural wrongdoing belongs to that organized system, while the absence of other-than-God helpers exposes the whole network as unable to rescue its members.

activation_trace.role: Loyal succession and following supply the relational chain through which dependence spreads.
Worshipped objects supply the named cultic centers the group is told to retain.
Departure from guidance supplies the network's propagated effect on many people.
Plural culpable wrongs collect the network's actions into the causal liability of the focus ayah.
Other-than-God marks the alternate dependency system whose efficacy is tested.
The worship reference in the focus clause sets the standard before which retained gods fail.
Effective support is the function the entire follower-and-deity network cannot perform.

structural_cues: 71:21 links following to leaders enlarged by wealth and children but producing loss.
71:22-24 proceeds through organized plotting, insistence on named gods, and the misdirection of many.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies followers, cultic objects, plotting, and propagated misdirection; I infer an organized dependency network whose failure is diagnosed by the focus clause. Alternatively, these may be several wrongs without forming one functional network.

changed_reading.before: Separate sinners discover that no helper is present.
changed_reading.after: A socially reproduced support system reaches judgment and is exposed as structurally incapable of helping anyone within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah stands between two repeated increase-prayers over the wrongdoers: first increased misdirection, then increased destruction. Its causal and passive sequence functions as the conversion hinge where accumulated deviation becomes enacted disintegration.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth make misdirection an accumulating process immediately before the focus.
Deviation from guidance supplies the state being amplified before judgment.
Putting a thing outside its proper place gives the repeated wrongdoer label a disordering function.
Repeated increase carries the same escalating syntax from deviation to destruction.
Withholding and confinement from right keep the same wrongdoer class active at the closing escalation.
Destruction, nullification, and breaking supply the terminal state being increased after the focus.
Missing the right course connects accumulated deviation to the focus's causal phrase.
Lethal drowning begins the material enactment of the amplified destructive state.
Ingress into fire carries that enactment forward rather than closing it at drowning.

structural_cues: 71:24 and 71:28 repeat وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا with different terminal nouns.
71:25 occupies the hinge position between the increase of misdirection and the increase of destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated frame, changed complements, and the intervening judgment sequence; I infer that 71:25 converts compounding deviation into compounding destruction. Alternatively, the two prayers may merely flank the report without making it a transformation operator.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports punishment caused by past sins.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the active hinge where an accumulating regime of misdirection crosses into an accumulating regime of destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same ingress root governs two sharply different destination-relations: compelled entry into fire in the focus and voluntary entry into Noah's house as a believer under a prayer for forgiveness. Entry becomes a sorting operation whose destination discloses security or exposure.

activation_trace.role: Covering sin and shielding its bearer supplies the protection surrounding the later house-entry.
Literal entry repeats the focus movement while changing agency, destination, and company.
Dwelling and shelter supply a protective interior opposed to the fire interior.
Settled security and trust characterize those whose entry leads into shelter and prayer.
The same literal ingress anchors the contrast at the focus's compelled fire-entry.
Kindled fire makes the focus interior consuming rather than sheltering.

structural_cues: 71:25 uses passive plural ingress into fire; 71:28 uses singular active ingress into my house.
The later entrant is immediately qualified by believing language and included in a forgiveness prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ingress with opposed destinations, agency, security, and prayer; I infer a destination-based sorting contrast. Alternatively, the house phrase may only delimit the prayer's recipients and not formally oppose the fire-entry.

changed_reading.before: Entry into fire is merely the second punishment.
changed_reading.after: Ingress is a sorting grammar: compelled entry leads into consuming exposure, while believing entry leads into shelter, security, and requested covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rain-missed-land branch is not the surface sense of خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ. It remains anchored through the packet's focus branch, abundant-rain context, and literal drowning; downstream prose should render it only as a branch-image reversal, never as a replacement translation of wrongdoing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ and أُغْرِقُوا within the same causal clause.

activation_trace.role: Land missed by rain supplies a physical non-arrival image latent beside the culpable sense.
Copious outflow supplies the beneficial rain whose possible missing is reversed.
Literal drowning makes destructive water the water that emphatically does not miss them.

changed_reading.before: Their culpable acts cause them to drown.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch image, what could miss the proper target or be missed by beneficial rain is answered by destructive water that does not miss its recipients.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ج د د mapping for وَجَدُوا and its shoreline branch. It remains valid as an activation because the focus itself joins failed finding to drowning and absent aid; downstream prose must call it a spatial resonance, not a lexical gloss of يَجِدُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أُغْرِقُوا ... فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا ... أَنصَارًا joins drowning directly to failed finding and rescue.

activation_trace.role: Literal drowning creates the water-space in which a shore would mark safety.
The non-dominant shoreline branch spatializes failed finding as the absence of a reachable edge.
Nearness short of the goal makes a seemingly close edge remain unreachable.
Concrete aid converts the unreachable shoreline into an image of rescue failure.

changed_reading.before: They fail to locate anyone who can help.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory spatial resonance, the drowned actors find no shore of rescue: every near edge falls short and no aid can bring them out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because shared root inventory does not make cosmic light and punitive fire semantically interchangeable. It remains anchored in the exact ن و ر occurrences and their distinct branches; downstream prose should present hostile or inverted luminosity as symbolic activation, not etymological identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا makes entry terminate in the fire branch of ن و ر.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the ordered cosmic light against which the focus fire is contrasted.
Kindled fire activates a consuming rather than orienting form within the same root inventory.
Ingress makes the changed luminosity a destination they enter rather than a sign they observe.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only a burning destination.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch activation, they enter an inverted luminosity: cosmic light that could orient is answered by fire that exposes and consumes.

strongest_changes: The focus sequence closes a long warning-and-deferral process at its fixed deadline.
Life-giving rain and rivers reverse into drowning, while rain's succoring function becomes unavailable.
The ayah acts as a hinge between increased misdirection in 71:24 and increased destruction in 71:28.
Repeated ingress distinguishes compelled entry into fire from believing entry into a sheltered house.
Follower, deity, and misdirection relations turn the missing helpers into the collapse of an organized support network.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed the focus from a flat punishment report into a set of directional reversals: warning to closure, provision to engulfment, self-covering to imposed enclosure, exit to ingress, open routes to route erasure, and cultic support to disclosed incapacity. The split وَجَدَ mapping also preserved a contained no-shore image that a conservative reading would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive sequence may mark immediate temporal succession, rhetorical compression, or both.
The counter-cycle and dual-ingress models depend on reading nearby directional parallels as deliberate contrasts rather than simple sequence.
The rain-miss, shoreline, and inverted-luminosity activations should remain explicitly exploratory and should not replace surface lexical senses.
